reason: £280 for four refurbished wheels is not far off what I can find on Marketplace or eBay if I haggle, and I'd have to drive out to Bexleyheath or Gillingham to collect, which I can't be bothered with. A new seller with no reviews doesn't make me rush either.
objection: I do not want to travel to collect, and for £280 I can usually haggle a set down locally or on eBay with delivery.
would_change_my_mind: Delivery to my door, or a price nearer £200 for a set that fits my car.
